The question of the river

The question was simple, but the answer took the city a long time. The company had built a bridge across the river, and the people who lived near the water were not sure it was a good idea. The mayor said the problem was money, but the engineers said the problem was the ground under the bridge. Nobody wanted to say the project was a mistake, because the work had already started.

In the morning the family walked to the market with the children, and the father bought bread and the mother bought fish. The market was busy because the weather was good, and the music from the square made the morning feel like a holiday. The children wanted the same thing every week, so the parents also bought fruit. The house at the end of the street had a garden, and the garden had a wall. The wall was old, but the door in the wall was new, and the family used the door every day because the road was dangerous.

The teacher asked the students a question about the war, and the students gave the same answer. The history of the country was long, so the teacher chose the part about the king and the church. The book on the table was open at the page about the castle, and the picture of the castle showed the river and the bridge.

Short line here.

  • The first reason is the cost of the land, and the second reason is the time the work will take.
  • The last reason is the weather, because the winter in the north is hard and the summer is short.

The doctor said the body needs sleep, and the mind needs rest, but the patient did not listen. The hospital was far from the village, so the family drove the car through the night, and the road was empty. In the end the child was fine, and the doctor said the fever was the only problem.
